title.narrative: RAFFORZAMENTO DELLA CAPACITÀ DI GESTIONE TRANSFRONTALIERA DEL DEL RISCHIO DI DISASTRI E DEI SISTEMI DI ALLERTA PRECOCE NEI BALCANI OCCIDENTALI
Strengthening transboundary collaboration and capacities on disaster risk reduction and early warning systems in the Western Balkans

description.narrative: Il progetto mira a migliorare la resilienza ai disastri nella regione dei Balcani occidentali attraverso una migliore conoscenza del rischio, una governance rafforzata, sistemi di allarme rapido multi-rischio migliorati (EWS) e la cooperazione transfrontaliera incentivata, concentrandosi su Albania, Macedonia del Nord e Serbia, con una partecipazione del Kosovo in eventi di formazione. L’obiettivo generale è migliorare la capacità di riduzione del rischio di catastrofi (DRR) e lo sviluppo e la gestione dell’EWS nei Balcani occidentali, concentrandosi sulla governance inclusiva, sull’empowerment della comunità e su una migliore preparazione e risposta alle catastrofi attraverso lo sviluppo di capacità e partenariati strategici. Ciò avverrà attraverso: 1) una maggiore capacità delle autorità statali e delle parti interessate di sviluppare efficaci sistemi di allerta precoce multi-rischio attraverso una migliore raccolta e gestione dei dati sui rischi; 2) rafforzando la governance del rischio di catastrofi e i processi decisionali a tutti i livelli; 3) potenziamento delle capacità di gestione delle catastrofi a livello locale, con l'obiettivo di sviluppare e sostenere l'attuazione delle strategie di DRR, integrare l'adattamento ai cambiamenti climatici e dare potere ai gruppi vulnerabili e alle donne come parte dell'iniziativa MCR2030 dell'UNDRR.

The project aims to enhance resilience to disasters in the Western Balkans region through better risk knowledge, strengthened governance, improved multi-hazard early warning systems (EWS) and transboundary cooperation focusing on Albania, North Macedonia and Serbia, with a regional engagement of Kosovo. The overall objective is to enhance Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) capacity and the development and management of EWS across the Western Balkans, focusing on inclusive governance, community empowerment, and improved disaster preparedness and response through capacity building and strategic partnerships. This will be done through: 1) increased capacity of state authorities and stakeholders to develop effective multi-hazard early warning systems through improved collection and management of risk knowledge and data; 2) strengthened disaster risk governance and decision-making processes across all levels; 3) enhanced disaster management capacities at the local level, aiming to develop and support the implementations of DRR strategies, integrate climate change adaptation, and empower vulnerable groups and women as part of UNDRR’s MCR2030 initiative.

tag.narrative: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls

By 2020, substantially increase the number of cities and human settlements adopting and implementing integrated policies and plans towards inclusion, resource efficiency, mitigation and adaptation to climate change, resilience to disasters, and develop and implement, in line with the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015–2030, holistic disaster risk management at all levels

By 2030, significantly reduce the number of deaths and the number of people affected and substantially decrease the direct economic losses relative to global gross domestic product caused by disasters, including water-related disasters, with a focus on protecting the poor and people in vulnerable situations
Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages
Ensure women’s full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership at all levels of decision-making in political, economic and public life
Integrate climate change measures into national policies, strategies and planning
Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable
Strengthen resilience and adaptive capacity to climate-related hazards and natural disasters in all countries
Strengthen the capacity of all countries, in particular developing countries, for early warning, risk reduction and management of national and global health risks
Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts
